definitions.explanation: Something or someone that provides support, whether physical (holding something up) or emotional/figurative (being a source of strength or encouragement). Often used for people who serve as a source of emotional strength.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支|ささ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I had the support of my family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支|ささ}えだ。

{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支|ささ}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}える→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to the support of many people, I was able to overcome the difficulties.

notes:
USAGE:
The noun form of the verb {支|ささ}える (to support). Frequently used in the pattern ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支|ささ}え (the support of ~) to express gratitude for emotional or practical help from others. Very common in speeches and thank-you messages.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支|ささ}え: emotional support
- ⟦{精神的|せいしんてき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧な{支|ささ}え: psychological support
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{支|ささ}え: great support
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支|ささ}えなし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: without the support of ~
